# ggtibble

The goal of `ggtibble` is to allow creation of similarly-formatted
figures as lists of ggplots (gglist) and tibbles of those lists with
captions. These are augmented with
[`knit_print()`](https://rdrr.io/pkg/knitr/man/knit_print.html) methods
enabling simple inclusion in reports.

## Installation

You can install the development version of `ggtibble` from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r

# install.packages("devtools")
devtools::install_github("humanpred/ggtibble")
```

## Example

This is a basic example which shows you how to solve a common problem:

``` r

library(ggtibble)
d_plot <-
  data.frame(
    A = rep(c("foo", "bar"), each = 4),
    B = 1:8,
    C = 11:18,
    Bunit = "mg",
    Cunit = "km"
  )
all_plots <-
  ggtibble(
    d_plot,
    ggplot2::aes(x = B, y = C),
    outercols = c("A", "Bunit", "Cunit"),
    caption = "All the {A}",
    labs = list(x = "B ({Bunit})", y = "C ({Cunit})")
  ) +
  ggplot2::geom_point() +
  ggplot2::geom_line()
knit_print(all_plots)
```

In an R Markdown or Quarto report, the `ggtibble` chunk option is a
one-line shorthand for the above: it auto-derives the chunk label, sets
`fig.cap` from the object’s caption, and runs
[`knit_print()`](https://rdrr.io/pkg/knitr/man/knit_print.html)
automatically.

    ```{r ggtibble="all_plots"}
    ```

# Package index

## All functions

- [`as_gglist()`](https://humanpred.github.io/ggtibble/reference/as_gglist.md)
  :

  Convert an object to a `gglist`

- [`extract_glue_expr()`](https://humanpred.github.io/ggtibble/reference/extract_glue_expr.md)
  :

  Extract all expressions to be evaluated by `glue()`

- [`gglist()`](https://humanpred.github.io/ggtibble/reference/gglist.md)
  : Generate a list of ggplots from a list of data.frames

- [`ggsave()`](https://humanpred.github.io/ggtibble/reference/ggsave.md)
  : Save a plot or list of plots

- [`ggtibble()`](https://humanpred.github.io/ggtibble/reference/ggtibble.md)
  : Make a tibble where one column is the data to plot, one is the
  gglist, and one is the caption

- [`` `%+%` ``](https://humanpred.github.io/ggtibble/reference/grapes-plus-grapes.md)
  :

  Use the `%+%` operator from `ggplot2` for `ggtibble` and `gglist`
  objects

- [`knit_print(`*`<gg>`*`)`](https://humanpred.github.io/ggtibble/reference/knit_print.gg.md)
  : Print a ggplot (usually within knit_print.gglist)

- [`knit_print(`*`<gglist>`*`)`](https://humanpred.github.io/ggtibble/reference/knit_print.gglist.md)
  [`knit_print(`*`<ggtibble>`*`)`](https://humanpred.github.io/ggtibble/reference/knit_print.gglist.md)
  : Print a list of plots made by gglist

- [`labs_glue()`](https://humanpred.github.io/ggtibble/reference/labs_glue.md)
  : Generate ggplot2 labels based on data in a ggtibble

- [`new_gglist()`](https://humanpred.github.io/ggtibble/reference/new_gglist.md)
  :

  Create a new `gglist` object

- [`new_ggtibble()`](https://humanpred.github.io/ggtibble/reference/new_ggtibble.md)
  :

  Create a new `ggtibble` object
